integrity: All-length proof with seven finite exact-rational cross-checks; same-model review only; no claim of external independent scientific audit or proven priority.
scientific_limitations: Applies to finite simple generalized theta graphs with at least two internally vertex-disjoint paths, each at least two edges, and strictly positive finite independent edge weights; third joint cumulants of distinct edge indicators only. Does not include all series-parallel graphs, infinite volumes, spanning-tree-only ensembles or fourth/higher cumulants.
title: A complete three-edge cumulant sign law for the weighted forest gas on theta networks
